item.title: 🌯💙💚 Burritos for the Bulldogs! 💚💙🌯
item.description:
🌯💙💚 Burritos for the Bulldogs! 💚💙🌯
Skip the cooking Wednesday night and let Chipotle feed the family while you support Boles JH Athletics! 🐾
📅 Wednesday, October 14th ⏰ 5–9 PM 📍 Chipotle – 5320 Kennedale Sublett Rd, Kennedale
25% of event sales go straight to the Boles JH Athletic Booster Club to support our athletes! 🏈🏐🏀
How to make it count: ✅ Show the flyer (on your phone is fine!) in the restaurant ✅ Or order online for pickup with code XCZ7HWD
⚠️ Delivery orders and gift cards don't count — pickup or dine-in only!
Grab your crew, tell your friends, and let's fill that Chipotle with green and blue! 💚💙
